caseName: Toucey v. New York Life Insurance
caseNameFull: Toucey v. New York Life Insurance Co. and Phoenix Finance Corp. v. Iowa-Wisconsin Bridge Co.

opinions.text:
On page 6 of the opinion in these cases, the words “have pro tanto amended” in lines twenty-five and twenty-six are changed to “qualify pro tanto.” The petitions for rehearing are denied.

Opinion reported as amended, ante, p. 133, line 14.
